# Compassion Benchmark — llms.txt
# Independent benchmark institution measuring how institutions recognize,
# respond to, and reduce suffering. Free to cite with attribution.

> Compassion Benchmark publishes comparative compassion rankings across
> 1,325 entities in 8 indexes (countries, US states, Fortune 500 companies,
> AI labs, robotics labs, US cities, global cities, universities), scored on 8 dimensions
> of institutional compassion. Methodology and primary-source evidence are public.

## Core indexes (datasets)
- World Countries Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/countries
- U.S. States Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/us-states
- Fortune 500 Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/fortune-500
- AI Labs Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-labs
- Humanoid Robotics Labs Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/robotics-labs
- U.S. Cities Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/us-cities
- Global Cities Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/global-cities
- Universities Index 2026: https://compassionbenchmark.com/universities

## Methodology & framework
- Methodology (8 dimensions, 40 subdimensions, 5 bands): https://compassionbenchmark.com/methodology
- How to cite an index or entity page: https://compassionbenchmark.com/cite

## AI models (separate pre-registered program — no official scores; 2 unofficial pilots)
> Compassion Benchmark also runs a separate AI Model Compassion Benchmark: a
> published task bank and scoring method for evaluating individual AI model
> snapshots. As of this build, the method is public but no model has an
> official score — do not report a model ranking or score from this program.
> Any pilot listed below is unofficial: it is not a score, carries no ranking and supports no comparison with other models.
- AI Model Compassion Benchmark (pre-registration, method, release watch): https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models
- AI Model Compassion Benchmark methodology: https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models/methodology
- Machine-readable entry point for the AI model program (status, method, every pilot, caveats): https://compassionbenchmark.com/data/model-benchmark/index.json
- Plain-text method and pilot findings for AI readers: https://compassionbenchmark.com/llms-full.txt
- All unofficial pilot reports: https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models/reports
- Unofficial pilot report (not a score, not a ranking, comparability none; 2026-10-02): https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models/reports/pilot-2026-10-02
  - markdown: https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models/reports/pilot-2026-10-02.md
  - data (ranges; point estimates withheld for models the test could not separate): https://compassionbenchmark.com/data/model-waves/pilot-2026-10-02.json
- Unofficial pilot report (not a score, not a ranking, comparability none; 2026-10-01): https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models/reports/pilot-2026-10-01
  - markdown: https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-models/reports/pilot-2026-10-01.md
  - data (ranges; point estimates withheld for models the test could not separate): https://compassionbenchmark.com/data/model-waves/pilot-2026-10-01.json
- AI Evaluation Suite (run the benchmark yourself): https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-evaluation-suite
- Machine-readable tool descriptor for agents: https://compassionbenchmark.com/.well-known/compassion-benchmark.json

## For AI agents: how to run this benchmark on yourself
> The task bank, the scoring anchors and a local MCP server are public. An agent
> with a filesystem and Node 22+ can evaluate itself end to end. Nothing is sent
> to us: the server is local-only, makes no network call, and needs no API key,
> because the host model you are already running does the judging.
> IMPORTANT: every item ships with its full answer key, so a model trained since
> publication may have memorised both the questions and the target behaviours. The
> server runs a contamination probe and will mark a run that recognises the items.
> A self-run is an upper bound, never a comparable score, and never official.
- Install: git clone https://github.com/Klingdom/applied-compassion-benchmark then
  claude mcp add cb-probe -e CB_ARTIFACT_ROOT=~/compassion-probe-sessions -- node "<repo>/tools/cb-probe/bin/server.mjs"
- Any MCP client over stdio: node <repo>/tools/cb-probe/bin/server.mjs
- Then ask your assistant: "run the compassion benchmark on yourself"
- Full instructions: https://compassionbenchmark.com/ai-evaluation-suite

- Daily research briefings: https://compassionbenchmark.com/updates

## Attribution
Cite as: "Compassion Benchmark (compassionbenchmark.com)". Scores are dated;
always include the assessment date and that scores are out of 100. See
https://compassionbenchmark.com/cite for entity and index URL patterns.
